run_homography_estimation: run the homography estimation example using TheseusLayer with LevenbergMarquardt optimizer and a CNN feature extractor
create_HomographyDataset: create a PyTorch Dataset that applies random geometric and photometric augmentations to images for homography estimation
build_SimpleCNN: build a 2-layer CNN model with BatchNorm and ReLU for extracting image features used in homography cost computation
run_prepare_data: run the data preparation function to download and extract RevisitOP1M dataset chunks for homography estimation
run_four_corner_dist: run the four corner distance function to compute L1 error between estimated and ground truth homography transforms
